title: Supplier materials
description: How a priced bill of materials is written — which columns, under what headings, how a standing is said —: data, in the plugin's jar (settings/plugin/suppliers/materials).

$schema.description: the schema this file is written to

file.description: what its file is called after the pcb's name: supplier-materials.csv

items.description: A column: its heading, and the field it shows — item, designators, quantity (on one pcb), needed (on all of them), value, footprint, component, part-number, manufacturer, supplier, standing, order-number, buy (how many have to be bought), stock, minimum-order, lead-time, status, currency, unit-price, total, page.

heading.description: what the column is headed with

field.description: what it shows, by the field's word
